svg.title: Restaurant management — core ER schema
svg.desc: PostgreSQL · 9 entities · Crow’s-foot notation · Physical schema PK primary key FK foreign key UQ unique ? nullable * generated column Endpoint symbols: bar = one, circle = zero, crow’s foot = many. SQL permits 0..many order lines; checkout requires at least one. Menu price = Regular. Large = 1.5 × Regular; order_item.unit_price preserves the charged price. Payment is optional and unique per order.
